body: Using the uploaded portrait, create a playful scene where the same adult person appears as both a realistic human and a towering stylized 3D companion. Match their face, hairstyle, outfit colors and gesture. Place both on the same sunlit street, with correct contact shadows and perspective. Give the larger character friendly proportions while keeping the smaller person photographic. The giant companion must be unmistakably a sculpted animated-film 3D character: enlarged expressive eyes, rounded simplified face, matte stylized skin and clean simplified hair clumps. Do not render the giant as a photorealistic enlarged human. Keep the smaller person fully photographic.
